cohort: Pregnant women with SLE or RA
finding: Pre-eclampsia and maternal SLE activity appear to be the key drivers for the high rate of preterm birth and medically indicated delivery in SLE, contrasting with RA where preterm labor is most often due to spontaneous onset.
mod_finding: This study comparing pregnancy outcomes in women with SLE and RA found that SLE pregnancies had higher rates of cesarean delivery, primarily driven by pre-eclampsia and maternal SLE activity.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as a birth <37 weeks gestation
